- Added a new API in IoUringIoHandler to dynamically adjust the number of workers at runtime.

Fixes #14648

reply.body:
Zero doesn't mean disabling this function.
“If the count being passed in is 0, then this command returns the current maximum values and doesn't modify the current setting” from [io_uring_register man](https://manpages.debian.org/unstable/liburing-dev/io_uring_register.2.en.html#IORING_REGISTER_IOWQ_MAX_WORKERS)
The current code does not support the semantics of passing in 0.
So I think it makes sense for us to restrict the input of 0.
